messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert — high 5xx ratio on inference-prod-main (shard-a). 5m window shows 6.2% 5xx. Incident INC-2027 created. Paging current oncall Tom.

Tom (oncall): Oncall here, looking at Grafana and k8s. Give me 90s.

Maya (eng-sre): I see a deployment completed ~8m ago for `inference-frontend:v2.0.7` and a correlated spike in pod readiness failures. gpux machines p95 latency spiking too.

Tom (oncall): If readiness probes are failing, we should rollback. Kicking rollback to previous stable: 
```
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/inference-frontend --to-revision=41
```

ops-bot: Rollback initiated by Tom. Notifying #incidents and oncall. (reaction :white_check_mark:)

Priya (sre): Autoscaler logs show scale events at the same time. Some pods entered CrashLoopBackOff with readiness probe 500; image and network ok. Could be a readiness-change in the new binary.

Juniper (eng-monitoring): Confirmed. Readiness endpoint `/healthz/ready` returning 500 from new replicas. Post-rollback, new pods from rev41 are becoming ready. 5xx rate trending down to 0.9%.

Tom (oncall): Rolling rollback completed. Monitoring closely. Thanks.

Maya (eng-sre): Quick customer impact note: approx 18k requests got 500s over ~10m. Affected customers include staging-sandbox-2 and internal-qa. No major production customers impacted based on top-key metrics.

Priya (sre): Creating a temporary silence for the noisy 5xx alert on inference-prod-main for 45 minutes to avoid repeated pages while we stabilize. Silence ID SLC-992.

ops-bot: Silence SLC-992 created by Priya for alert:inference-5xx on inference-prod-main until 45 minutes from now.

Juniper (eng-monitoring): After rollback metrics look normal. p95 latency back to baseline. Proposal: adjust alert rule from 1.0% -> 1.6% for 5m and add a deploy suppression that suppresses the alert for 12m after any successful deploy event to reduce deploy-related noise. Also add an annotation to the alert linking to deploy metadata.

Tom (oncall): I support a deploy-suppression window. We need a dashboard panel that overlays deploy events with 5xx rate and pod readiness to make triage faster.

Maya (eng-sre): I'll open a follow-up: OPS-8110 for runbook updates (include explicit rollback commands and who to page for large customers). Assign Juniper for dashboard work.

Juniper (eng-monitoring): Creating MON-3198 to: (1) bump 5xx threshold to 1.6% (2) add deploy-suppression 12m (3) add a deploy-vs-5xx overlay panel in Grafana. Will include test plan and link OPS-8110.

Priya (sre): We should validate the new threshold won't hide real regressions. Plan: run synthetic test in staging that injects 5xx for a short period, then a controlled dry-run in prod during a maintenance window.

Tom (oncall): Agreed. I'll schedule a maintenance window and coordinate dry-run with SRE. No customer-impacting tests in prod without ops visibility.

ops-bot: Maintenance window requested by Tom: MW-498 on 2026-09-03 01:30-02:30 UTC for synthetic alert validation.

Maya (eng-sre): Post-incident checklist: (1) confirm silence SLC-992 removed if no regression (Priya) (2) add rollback steps and contact lists to runbook (Maya) (3) update alert rule docs and rationale (Juniper) (4) run validation during MW-498 (Tom).

Priya (sre): I'll add a calendar reminder to revisit silence at 20 minutes and will manually remove if all good. Also posting a short note to #customer-impact so support can log any affected accounts.

Juniper (eng-monitoring): Preview of new dashboard panels pushed to staging: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/mon-3198/deploy-correlation. Please review and comment. I'll add unit tests for alert logic in the alerting repo.

Tom (oncall): Error rate <0.3% for 15 minutes. Marking incident INC-2027 resolved in PagerDuty and opening PM-2027 for postmortem tracking. Handoff to Maya for follow-up items. :thumbsup:

Maya (eng-sre): Root cause for postmortem: change to readiness handler in v2.0.7 that can return 500 under load; will add stricter rollout checks. Owners assigned in OPS-8110.

Juniper (eng-monitoring): Will schedule the alert-change validation during MW-498 and add expected metrics and acceptance criteria to MON-3198. Also adding an eval harness test to simulate deploy spike.

Priya (sre): I'll make sure SLC-992 auto-expires; I'll also manually verify removal after stabilization. Posting a short summary to #incidents after the postmortem is written.

Tom (oncall): Thanks team. Leaving note in rotation: follow up on MON-3198 and OPS-8110 in 24h. Closing my oncall thread.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2027 status changed to resolved. Postmortem PM-2027 created and linked. (reaction :tada:)
